headline: US Approves SpaceX Plan for Starmind Satellite Constellation
summary: The United States approved SpaceX's plan to send a million data satellites into space for the Starmind constellation, aiming to meet growing demand for AI computing power.
why: SpaceX is a private aerospace manufacturer and space transportation services company expanding into satellite-based data and computing infrastructure.

impacts.name: SpaceX
impacts.why: Regulatory approval allows the company to execute its large-scale deployment plans.
